title: COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Tract No. 73184, located at 8413-8421 West Blackburn Avenue, westerly of Orlando Avenue.
text:
[Council File 26-1622; CD 5]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Tract No. 73184, located at 8413-8421 West Blackburn Avenue, westerly of Orlando Avenue.
Recommendation for Council action:
APPROVE the final map of Tract No. 73184, located at 8413-8421 West Blackburn Avenue, westerly of Orlando Avenue and accompanying Subdivision Improvement Agreement and Contract with security documents.
Owner: 2SKMB LLC ; Surveyor: Shawn Ohannessian
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The City Engineer reports that the subdivider has paid a fee of $18,150 for the processing of this final tract map pursuant to Section 19.02(A)(2) of the Los Angeles Municipal Code. No additional City funds are needed.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
